# API Requirements Quality Checklist: API Layer

**Purpose**: Reviewer check that the API layer requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before task generation. Covers API contract and errors, filtering and index behavior, non-functional targets, and security and privacy.
**Created**: 2026-10-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## API Contract & Error Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec itself (not only the plan contract) define which fields each report list row contains? [Gap, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK002 Are HTTP status codes for not-found, invalid input, and unreadable-file cases specified, or only described as "the correct status meaning"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the error message structure defined, or only that it must "name the invalid input"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the status category for a single-item request on an unreadable stored file stated, or only that it must "not crash"? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the pagination parameter names, default page size (50), and maximum page size (200) all stated in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the total count in a paged response defined as the filtered total or the whole-archive total? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements clear on whether the verdict filter accepts one verdict per request or several? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the requirements for a stored report with zero claims defined for each list and detail response, not only for the verdict filter? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Filtering & Index Requirements

- [ ] CHK009 Is the tie-break order defined for reports that share the same fact-check timestamp? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the spec state the time basis for the date filter (UTC or local), or only "calendar date"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the requirements for a refresh that fails partway through stated, including whether the previous index stays in use? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the behavior defined when the storage directory is missing entirely, as distinct from present but empty? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the behavior defined when the index file exists but is corrupt or built by an older version? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the content of the refresh result (which items were indexed and which were skipped) specified, or left to the implementation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "reported as skipped" defined: to whom, and through which interface? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the spec define how the owner triggers an index refresh, given that FR-010 requires one but names no interface? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are the hardware and data conditions under which the performance targets apply (SC-001, SC-002) stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "under 1 second" specified as a single-request or percentile measure? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the 10-second startup target (SC-004) tied to a stated cold or warm start condition? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 Are concurrency requirements (number of simultaneous requests) defined? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK021 Are logging requirements specified beyond "logged" (what is logged and in what form)? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the archive sizes in SC-001, SC-002, and SC-004 stated consistently with each other and with the Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001–SC-004]

## Security & Privacy Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Is the local-only binding a requirement, or only a default in the Assumptions? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the bounds of the no-authentication decision stated (what must not be exposed, and what would trigger revisiting it)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK025 Are validation requirements for path inputs (video ID) specified to prevent access outside the storage directory? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the scope of "returned unchanged" in FR-015 defined (which fields, and whether any transformation is allowed)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK027 Are the requirements for digest responses defined for files that lack a disclaimer before the one-time data fix runs? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the owner, timing, and completion check for the verdict and disclaimer data migrations specified as requirements? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
